reason: Two changes to the job, each with no cost on an ordinary pull request beyond the scan. tests/test_installer_legacy_hooks_native.py and tests/test_client_install_ux_native.py (the native copies that read rust/ files) join only the step for live tests that read rust/ files, which runs on a Rust-only change: an ordinary pull request's guards run skips that step, and the Rust-only run's cost is the 9.3-minute estimate in ci_budget.json (legacy hooks 26 cases in 30.9 s serially in WSL; the static copy under a second). The Tree-wide guards step also runs tests/test_installer_bash32.py, an in-process scan of the eight installer and preflight shell files under ops/ for what bash 3.2 misreads, with no setup, service or install and under a second (record 2026-11-15-09356acf on #1541).
